_meta.description: Synthetic customer feedback records for the Product Discovery Agent demo. All names, companies, and quotes are fabricated for teaching purposes only.

records.comment: Our night-shift analysts stare at this dashboard for hours. A dark theme would reduce eye strain considerably.
Please add dark mode. Half our SOC team works overnight and the bright UI is rough on the eyes.
Small thing, but a dark mode toggle would be nice for late-night bookkeeping sessions.
Every other app I use has dark mode, this one feels dated without it.
Battery drain on OLED laptops is noticeably worse with the current bright theme during travel.
I use the product mostly at night and the white background is jarring in a dark room.
Would love dark mode, several of us have light sensitivity and the current UI is uncomfortable.
Our accessibility office flagged the bright UI as a concern for staff with migraines. Dark mode was suggested as a mitigation.
Not urgent, but a dark theme would make the evening review workflow more pleasant.
Requesting dark mode again - came up in our team retro as the top requested cosmetic feature.
I need to approve requests while away from my desk. A mobile app would let me do quick approvals on the go.
Our field technicians can't access the tool without a laptop. A mobile app would fix that gap.
The mobile web experience is unusable on our tablets. We need a native app for warehouse staff.
Would use a mobile app daily just for quick status checks between meetings.
Push notifications for urgent alerts would be a game changer, currently we rely on email which is too slow.
Not a dealbreaker for us, mobile web is fine most days.
We record dozens of customer calls a week and nobody has time to write summaries. AI summaries would save hours.
Would love auto-generated action items after each meeting, we keep losing track of follow-ups.
Our PMs spend an hour after every planning meeting writing recap notes. Automating this would be huge.
I'd like a quick bullet-point summary emailed to me after calls I miss.
Concerned about where transcripts get stored, but the summarization concept itself is appealing.
records.pain_point: manual note-taking overhead / data handling concern

records.comment: Took our team almost two weeks to fully configure the product. The initial setup steps are confusing.
I almost gave up during setup, there's no guidance on what to do first.
New hires need a full day of hand-holding just to get started. A guided walkthrough would help a lot.
We didn't discover the reporting feature until month two because nothing pointed us to it during setup.
The empty dashboard on day one was confusing, I didn't know where to start.
Our onboarding specialist has to walk every new account through the same manual steps. This should be self-serve.
Requesting a checklist or progress tracker for setup, right now it's unclear what's left to configure.
We need to share monthly reports with leadership who don't have product access. PDF export would solve this.
Our accountant asks for a PDF copy of the invoice summary every month, currently we screenshot everything.
Would like to print a clean PDF version of my report instead of the messy browser print output.
Compliance requires us to archive signed-off reports as PDF. Right now we use a third-party converter.
